# BlenderMCP

> A Model Context Protocol server that lets multiple LLM clients collaborate on shared Blender 3D instances over an OAuth-isolated message bus.

This is the apex marketing site. The substantive content for LLMs lives on the documentation site.

## Primary

- [Documentation (llms.txt)](https://docs.blender.bet/llms.txt): Full Diátaxis-organized index of tutorials, how-to guides, reference, and explanation.
- [Documentation (HTML root)](https://docs.blender.bet/): Same content, rendered.
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/rsp2k/blender-mcp): Source, addon code, installation scripts.

## Optional

- [Reference MCP server](https://mcp.blender.bet/): Public OAuth-protected MCP endpoint. Start an MCP-spec OAuth flow here to connect.
